The pork hotpot (with tender pork belly, napa cabbage, red dates, goji berries) was the star of the show – incredibly delicious, comforting, and full of rich, nourishing flavors. It was steaming hot and perfectly balanced, one of the best hotpots I've had in Singapore. The Vietnamese chicken skewers were super tasty too – juicy, well-marinated with that…

I ordered their coconut coffee and it was really good — the coconut blended so well with the coffee, perfectly balanced. Headed up to the 3rd floor where the ambiance was relaxing and cozy. The terrace area gives you a lovely overview of the street below. A great spot…

The coconut coffee is absolutely outstanding! The strong, rich coffee combined with creamy coconut milk creates a perfect balance of flavors. Its sweetness is just right—not overly sweet—allowing the authentic coffee taste to shine through. Best of all, it comes at an affordable price, making it an excellent choice for coffee lovers. Highly recommended! ☕🥥✨

We visited Cộng Cafe near St. Joseph’s Cathedral, and it turned out to be one of the highlights of our trip. As someone from the Philippines, I really appreciated how lively and welcoming the place felt. Its location, just steps away from the cathedral, makes it a perfect stop—especially for Catholics like me who wanted to visit this beautiful landmark. With its wooden pillars, tiled courtyard, lush greenery and timeless atmosphere, the house provides a fascinating glimpse into the lifestyle of a Northern Vietnamese family in centuries past. A wonderful place to appreciate local culture, history and the charm of old Bat Trang village.
Bat Trang is not only known for its pottery, but also has literature temple, community hall, and many other places. Recommended to visit and buy some pottery.

The old portery village in Vietnam where people could find the ways that they make ceramics and portery. People could also experience to make one by ourselves. But one thing, its a bit touristy and busy now.

It is a great shop to pick up small souvenirs for if you don’t want the typical tourist-y takeaways. It seems like every single piece is different from the other. rv.t: This market is honestly a good place to visit if you’re looking for cheap shopping in Hanoi. They sell almost everything here, especially luggage, chocolates, dried fruits, coffee, snacks, souvenirs, clothes, toys, shades, and lots of random items. We bought an XL luggage here for around 600,000 VND, which was honestly pretty cheap compared to mall prices. There are also tons of counterfeit bags, wallets, shoes, and…

Dong Xuan Market is one of Hanoi's oldest and largest markets, offering an authentic glimpse into the city's local trading culture. Located in the heart of the Old Quarter, it is a bustling marketplace where locals and tourists come to shop for a wide variety of goods. The market is spread across multiple floors and sells everything from clothing, footwear, bags, household items, souvenirs, electronics, and local…

Wholesale shopping place for clothes, trousers, accessories, snacks. If you like to bargain, this place is for you. If not, better not come here. The market is narrow and there are so many shops selling all the way to the alley that it is not comfortable to walk along it.

There were small plastic stools, bright neon signs, cold beer, and the smell of street food everywhere. We walked around the area and tried some local dishes. At night, the whole street fills up with locals and tourists all drinking and laughing together. It felt…

Visited Hanoi Beer Street, and this place is the definition of local vibe in Hanoi. The entire street is packed with small plastic chairs, cheap draft beer (Bia Hoi), and a super lively atmosphere. It feels raw, chaotic, and authentic — exactly what you expect from a real local nightlife experience. Beer is incredibly cheap, and you can just sit down anywhere, order a glass, and enjoy people-watching. The energy…

Theeeeee best place to visit during the night in old quarters. It's completely different during the day so keep in mind to visit here after 9pm The vibes are great but make sure to not enter any Shady places. Just buy some snacks, beer and watch the show for fun. Be polite and straight forward.

The best view i had at the peak of mua cave! Photos do not do the justice ! Go earlier 3 hours is just nice ! Go to lotus pond too!

Arrived at Hang Mua with a small tour group on Saturday 20/06/26. a beautiful area to visit & cafes along the way + a gift shop. Unfortunately I couldn't climb up the steep steps due my medical condition. Spent a couple of hours exploring the area.

From outside, you can find their signage as An Bread Cafe. Their hospitality and service were great. Very friendly staffs. Food is also delicious and presentable. Try out their bun cha, their banh mi sandwiches, coffees and it was the best so far with proper seatings especially when you have senior parents with you.

the staff is super friendly & sweet. the entire atmosphere is super laid-back and cute. and the food and coffee are AMAZING! literally a 11/10. not only is the taste absolutely scrumptious but also the aesthetic is absolutely beautiful. it warms the heart of every coffee lover. i‘d defo recommend this cafe to try traditional vietnamese coffee & banh mi WITHOUT coriander :)

2290.a: Kaikono Falls, Sekiya, Nasushiobara, Tochigi 329-2801, Japan
2290.aj: 〒329-2801 栃木県那須塩原市関谷 回顧の滝

rv.t: 訪問したことのあるもみじ谷大吊橋でなく、初めて回顧の吊り橋と回顧の滝に行ってみました。降雪が残る中慎重に進むと、なかなか立派な吊り橋と滝がありました。水がきれいで、景色も良かったです。紅葉の時期ならさらに良かったでしょう。
滝までは蟇石園地駐車場から、片道徒歩で１５分ですが、滝を見るには未舗装路や階段等の 勾配を下り塩原ダムにかかる吊橋まで行く必要があります。 道路下の斜面に沿って流れているため、吊橋まで行き、振り返って見るかたちになるので、 残念ながら、道路からは遠望も出来ません。 駐車可能な場所から吊橋は見ることができます。

2291.a: Kuniga Coast Walking Trail, Urago, Nishinoshima, Oki District, Shimane 684-0211, Japan
2291.aj: 〒684-0211 島根県隠岐郡西ノ島町浦郷摩天崖遊歩道
catj: ハイキング コース

rv.t: 国賀海岸の大自然を間近に感じられる、西ノ島屈指の絶景ルート。 摩天崖を見渡す映像に惹かれ、遊歩道完歩にチャレンジ。国賀海岸から摩天崖を往復。 疲れも吹き飛ぶ景色に、思わずため息。 ぜひ、一生に一度は訪れることをおすすめしたい。 【注意点】 * 牛馬のふんはかなり多い * ダニ対策推奨 → 長ズボン・長袖が安心。 * 風が非常に強い日あり * 自販機・売店なし * 夏は日陰がほぼ無い
馬糞牛糞ハエそれら含めて魔天崖。嫌なら来ない事をおすすめします。ネットでの綺麗な写真からはわからないことって沢山ありますね！とにかく全て含めて最高の場所。現実離れした光景に言葉を失った！帰りの登りはしんどかったけど良い思い出となりました。
往路は飽きない絶景ハイキングが楽しめます。復路の登り返しはやや億劫でしたが、絶景を振り返りながら歩いたら楽しく気づけばあっという間の往復でした。道も整備されていて歩きやすいです。パンフレットやネットではぐるりと周回できるとの事でしたが順路が現地では分からず、船の時間があったので往復にしました。周回するならパンフレットやネットを頼りにする事をお勧めします。

Hanoi air sucks. However the walk around West Lake was quite pleasant. 15km for the loop. There are quite a few parts where you will need to walk on the road.

We really like the calm neighborhood feel here and could imagine renting a flat for a while - there were gyms, shops, plenty of eateries ...but were very disappointed for two reasons: - the air and lake pollution was very disappointing. - there are some nice looking bldgs with apts to rent but several face multiple city blocks that have been demolished and filled with rubble. rv.t: Tried this local bánh mì spot and it was already crowded—definitely a good sign! You can see people lining up outside, which says a lot about how popular the place is. We ordered the traditional bánh mì with pork belly and with the sausage. Bread was crispy with savoury filling. I also like the street-style vibe—simple but authentic. You order, wait a bit, then enjoy your freshly made sandwich. The branding “a loaf…

Really loved this bánh mì place! The bread was perfectly crispy but still easy to bite into, which is a big deal for me when it comes to bánh mì. I ordered the pork combo pan, but I honestly wish I had gone for the sandwich version instead. Their salt coffee was amazing—the best I had on this trip! 🤩 Highly recommend stopping by if you’re in the area. 💗

Had the BBQ pork Banh mi. The crispy pork belly wasn’t available. I’ve walked past in the afternoon and there were about 50 people waiting. I came in the morning and could get straight in. Bread was hot and crusty, generous pate, fresh cucumber, coriander and chilli which you dont always get at other places. Was definitely the best Banh mi I got. The salted cream coffee was delicious too. Good coffee to cream ratio

rv.t: I spent about an hour and a half exploring this museum and found it to be a fascinating experience. Even though a few sections were closed for renovation, there was still a lot to see and learn. The exhibits offer a deep insight into Vietnam’s history and culture, helping visitors better understand the country's struggles and achievements. The displays are informative and well organized, with English explanations…

This museum is a gem. It tells not one, but two important phases in Vietnam's history. Getting there was fussless. I took a Grab bike from Old Town and got there within 5 mins. The purchase of tickets was seamless. I was there on a Saturday morning. I went straight to the counter, paid 25k VND (or 20k; i can't recall) and got it straightaway. Some may ask if there is a need to rent an audio guide, which cost 100k…

I visited the Hoa Lo Prison Relic, also known as the “Hanoi Hilton”, a couple of days ago and found it to be a very somber yet eye-opening experience. The museum covers a deep and tragic history connected to both the French colonial period and the Vietnam/US War. You can hire an audio headset that guides you through the museum in your own language, although I chose to explore on my own and read more about the…

rv.t: ⭐⭐⭐⭐☆ My visit to Ha Long Bay was beautiful, but a bit less smooth than I expected. The scenery is honestly incredible. The limestone islands rising straight out of the water look almost unreal, especially when the mist sits low over the bay. Cruising through it feels like moving through a painting, with new rock formations appearing around every turn. The views from the boat are easily the highlight of the entire…

Ha Long Bay was one of the most breathtaking places we have ever visited. We spent two nights on a cruise and made the most of the experience. Exploring different parts of the bay, we were constantly surrounded by spectacular limestone formations, caves, and small islands. The scenery changes throughout the day and remains stunning at every moment. Staying overnight on the cruise was an experience in itself…
Brilliant, beautiful area to explore. Highly recommend the tour from Emeraude (see my review there for details). Stunning landscapes - absolutely incredible.

During the day, we walked along the streets near Hoan Kiem Lake and saw local artists sitting outside drawing portraits. We also came across a flower seller on a bicycle wearing a traditional hat, which was a lovely sight. We saw many stores and street food vendors as well. We stopped at a…

Beautiful piece of Vietnam. It has a mix of old charm & modern infusion. A collection mis matched buildings with a lot of character & old school charm. I love this city & I would definitely be returning. There are lots of small boutiques stores & mini market stalls, food places, eateries & restaurant & cafes. So much variety and plenty of options you cannot go wrong!

Hanoi Old Quarter is an amazing place and definitely worth 5. We really loved the look and atmosphere – it’s busy, full of people (including lots of tourists), but that’s exactly what makes it so special. There’s energy everywhere you look. There are plenty of spots to eat and grab a beer, and we ended up sitting in one of them just watching the life of the city go by – motorbikes, locals, the constant movement. It…

The beach features a long stretch of soft golden sand, clean surroundings, and clear blue water, making it ideal for a morning walk, swimming, or simply enjoying the sea breeze. One of the things I liked most about My Khe Beach is how spacious it feels. Even when there are visitors around, there is usually plenty of…

My Khe Beach is one of the best beaches in Da Nang. The sand is soft and clean, the water is clear, and the beach is perfect for swimming or taking a relaxing walk. There are plenty of cafés and restaurants nearby, making it easy to spend a whole day here. The sunrise is especially beautiful. A must-visit if you’re in Da Nang!

My Khe Beach – Da Nang 🌊 Located along Vo Nguyen Giap Street, My Khe Beach is one of Da Nang’s most famous beaches and is often recognized as one of the most beautiful beaches in the world. The beach features a long stretch of soft white sand, clear blue water, and gentle waves, making it ideal for swimming, walking, and various beach activities. The place also felt not so clean and cozy enough to eat inside, but at least the AC on. We ordered two bánh mìs: one with chicken and one with egg and vegetables. You can get everything here — souvenirs, clothes, silk materials, coffee, chocolates, fruits, and even tailor-made outfits. Love the busy local vibe, but be ready… must bargain kaw kaw! Prices can be marked up, so don’t be shy 💯 Definitely a must-visit when in Da Nang!

Han Market is a lively and very busy local market. Be prepared for the heat and lots of people. You’ll mainly find T-shirts, clothing, shoes, handbags and many replica brands. The sellers at the front can be quite pushy, and some even refused to let us try on the clothes. If that happens, simply walk further into the market. The vendors at the back were much friendlier and usually allowed us to try items on. Don’t…

One of the best markets in Da Nang for shopping and we found this market best in Vietnam if we compare Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh with this one. The rates are reasonable already so negotiations are not much. Everything from clothes, Shoes, bags, electronics and food items are available here. Carry large bags if you want to avoid carrying so many things in your hands. Keep in mind that this place is dense and sweaty due…

2301.a: Vietnam, Đà Nẵng, Hội An, Old Town, Hai Bà Trưng, ホイアン旧市街地
2301.aj: ベトナム Đà Nẵng, Hội An, Old Town, Hai Bà Trưng, ホイアン旧市街地

rv.t: You better visit here. There are a lot of photogenic places.
The lanterns lit up at night were beautiful✨ The food was delicious too! Just strolling around made me feel like I was in a different world😊

ベトナムのホイアン旧市街に行ってきました。 お昼過ぎに到着しましたが、かなり蒸し暑く、すでに多くの観光客でにぎわっていました。街をゆっくり散策しようと思っていましたが、人の多さもあって、落ち着いて見て回るには少し不向きかもしれません。 それでも、古い街並みやお店の雰囲気はとても魅力的で、歩いているだけでも楽しめます。革製品のお店やスーツの仕立て屋さんも多く、価格はかなりお手頃。ただ、作っても着る機会があるかどうかは少し考えてしまいます。 夜になると、さらに人が増えて一気に活気づき、まさにお祭りのような雰囲気に。特に手漕ぎの小舟に灯されたランタンの光はとても幻想的で印象的でした。灯籠流しも体験でき、短い時間でしたが心に残るひとときでした。 混雑は気になりますが、それを含めても一度は訪れる価値のあるおすすめの観光地だと思います。

2302.a: My Son, Thánh địa Mỹ Sơn, Duy Xuyên, Quảng Nam, Vietnam
2302.aj: ミーソン遺跡 Thánh địa Mỹ Sơn, Duy Xuyên, Quảng Nam, ベトナム
2302.nb: Thánh địa Mỹ Sơn, Duy Xuyên District
2302.ed: Remains of Hindu temples built between the 4th & 14th centuries, with red brick & ornate carvings.
2302.edj: 4～14 世紀にかけて建てられたヒンドゥー教寺院の遺跡群。赤れんがを使い、細かな装飾が施されている。

rv.t: Really cool Hindu temples built by the Champa Kingdom in the 4th-to-13th-century. Most of them were ruined by the war in the 60's. It's in a national park surrounded by beautiful nature. It's nice because you could see the ruins and then have a really peaceful walk around the park. They also have a bunch of cafes and food in and outside the park.

First of all we were lucky to have been there on a rainy day. So not too hot at all. Also the wetness brought out the brilliance of the colours, strong reds and greens, all surrounded by the jungle. Very interesting site, also understanding the ancient influence of Hindu here in this area of Vietnam. Come visit

This was an interesting short tour. The place is amazing. The history surrounding My Son, the who, what and why, of this particular area is fascinating. The Indian Government had been instrumental in uncovering some of the secrets here with ongoing restoration taking place. Try to go when its not too hot. Its an easy walk. Keep your eyes open and you may get to see some of the wildlife happening in the tree-tops!…

2303.a: The Marble Mountains, 81 Huyền Trân Công Chúa, Hoà Hải, Ngũ Hành Sơn, Đà Nẵng 550000, Vietnam
2303.aj: マーブル マウンテン ダナン 81 Huyền Trân Công Chúa, Hoà Hải, Ngũ Hành Sơn, Đà Nẵng 550000 ベトナム
2303.ed: Network of 5 marble mountains with multiple caves, elaborate temples & viewing outlooks.
2303.edj: 大理石でできた 5 つの山。多くの洞窟、壮麗な寺院、展望スポットがある。

rv.t: Marble Mountains is one of the most impressive attractions in Da Nang and an absolute must-visit. The combination of ancient caves, beautiful pagodas, and breathtaking viewpoints makes it a unique experience. We spent a few hours exploring the mountain, climbing through the caves, and enjoying the peaceful atmosphere. The panoramic view from the top overlooking Da Nang and the coastline is unforgettable and well…

A must visit attraction in Da Nang. We took the elevator instead of hiking up. The tickets for elevator and entry can be purchased at the booth there. There is a little hike to reach the cave temples even from the point where elevator drops you. So be ready to hike with closed shoes and comfortable clothing. The natural beauty of the place comes alive as you enter the cave temple. The most popular is the Huyen Khong…

It costs VND 40k to enter and you have to purchase at the ticket booth which is very easy to find. There’s also a short elevator you can take (but you have to pay a fee) from the ground to I guess the 1st level if you don’t want to take the first steep stairs up. There are a handful of caves, a lot of walking so make sure to wear comfortable shoes also because some of the caves are a bit tight and you have to…

2304.a: Izakaya Mizuho, 101 Kusatsu, Agatsuma District, Gunma 377-1711, Japan
2304.aj: 〒377-1711 群馬県吾妻郡草津町草津１０１ いざかや水穂
2304.ed: Diners like this izakaya's delicious local dishes, including fresh "ginhikari" trout sashimi, flavorful "motsu-ni" stew, and crispy tempura, with generous portion sizes. They also highlight the wide selection of sake and shochu, the cozy atmosphere, and the kind, helpful staff. Some reviews mention the service can be rushed.
2304.edj: この居酒屋を利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、新鮮な「ギンヒカリ」の刺身、風味豊かなもつ煮、そして幅広でつるつるとしたひもかわうどんが高く評価されています。特に、舞茸の天ぷらが美味しいという声が多くあります。また、居心地の良い地元の雰囲気、豊富な種類の日本酒、英語のメニューやベビーチェアを用意してくれる親切なスタッフも好評のようです。 一方で、サービスが急かされているように感じたというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: Tried both inaka and himokawa noodle, both are delicious on its own way. Himokawa is silky smooth, inaka is chewy flavourful. I preferred inaka. Request for English menu, the tempura mushroom from hot yubatake is so nice! The place is cozy too, love it.

Izakaya near the center of Kusatsu Onsen. Everything we ordered was excellent, especially the salt-grilled whole kama-yaki—juicy, rich, and perfectly seasoned. The Toshio-style fried tofu was crisp outside and soft inside, deeply comforting. The donabe claypot rice was fragrant with a great crispy bottom, and the “Before Dawn (Yoake-mae)” sake paired beautifully. Cozy tatami seating, calm local atmosphere.

Nice and cosy restaurant! The staff and owner are super friendly. Tho the owner mainly speaks Japanese, he tried to recommend dishes to us. And all the dishes are great and inexpensive! 水穗 is the best in Kusatsu for sure! P.s. I was disappointed that some restaurants in Kusatsu rejected to serve foreigners, except 水穗.

2304.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

2305.a: Matsumoto, 486-5 Kusatsu, Agatsuma District, Gunma 377-1711, Japan
2305.aj: 〒377-1711 群馬県吾妻郡草津町草津４８６−５ 上州地粉うどん まつもと
2305.ed: Diners like this restaurant's delicious and unique wide, flat himokawa udon noodles, as well as the crispy and flavorful tempura, especially the maitake mushroom. They also highlight the reasonable prices for a tourist area and the efficient service, with orders taken while waiting to ensure quick food delivery.
2305.edj: このレストランを訪れたユーザーは、美味しくて珍しい幅広のひもかわうどんや、サクサクで風味豊かな天ぷら、特に舞茸の天ぷらを高く評価しています。また、観光地でありながら手頃な価格であることや、待ち時間中に注文を取ることで料理の提供が早いことなど、効率的なサービスも特徴として挙げられています。

rv.t: Found some good reviews abt this restaurant online, and luckily there was no queue when we came for dinner around 5pm on Saturday. Its located along the way to the Sainokawara onsen. I really liked the thin, slippery udon noodles in cold dipping sauce - the seaweed made it taste even better. The sauce was normal, but the combination was great. The donkatsu rice included in the 1200¥ was nice, but nothing too…

A must try spot in the area for udon noodles, especially if you enjoy wide flat noodles. There was a long queue, but the staff managed it very efficiently so the wait moved steadily. By the time we were seated, the food arrived within a few minutes. I ordered the pork katsu set and the soup was exactly what we needed after standing outside in the intense cold. The noodles were slightly chewy but leaned more towards…

I really enjoyed my visit to Matsumoto Soba. The dining space is quite limited, so it may feel cramped during busy hours, but the food makes up for it. The soba tasted excellent with a very classic Japanese style that felt truly authentic. Simple, well-executed flavors and traditional preparation made the meal memorable. A great place to try genuine soba if you don’t mind the small space.

2305.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 10:30

2306.a: Kusatsu Yubatake Manten, 2F 116-2 Kusatsu, Agatsuma District, Gunma 377-1711, Japan
2306.aj: 〒377-1711 群馬県吾妻郡草津町草津１１６−２ 2F 草津湯畑まんてん
2306.ed: Diners like this restaurant's delicious and hearty kamameshi, which offers various options like chicken and maitake mushroom or wagyu beef, and can be enjoyed as dashi chazuke. They also highlight the reasonable prices for the generous portions and the clean, bright atmosphere. Guests mention the staff are friendly and accommodating, and the mobile ordering system is convenient.
2306.edj: このお店を利用した人は、鶏と舞茸きのこ、和牛など様々な種類がある釜飯を高く評価しています。釜飯はボリュームがあり、だし茶漬けとしても楽しめると好評です。また、手頃な価格で量が多く、清潔で明るい雰囲気が特徴です。スタッフは親切で丁寧な対応をしてくれるという声や、モバイルオーダーシステムが便利だという意見もあります。

rv.t: Dinner time and Onsen night. Didn’t book hotel dinner, going out to eat should be good in this area. And it turned out to be right. These are rice cooked in a metal pot, kamameshi. We ordered a Salmon combination pot and a beef pot, both delicious. They cooked the rice with sauce in and after mixing the meat with the rice, the aroma was satisfying. Another way to eat was to add broth to the rice, rather good to eat…

Kusatsu Yubatake Manten is one restaurant that you don't want to miss when you visit Kusatsu. The food was delicious and the service was excellent. One of the staff, I assume a Manager, spoke good English. Their kama meshi (pot cooked rice) was yummy and authentic. Before you finish eating the whole bowl of rice, leave some of it and add their FREE broth. This brings the dish to another level. Definitely and highly…

My best restaurant in kusatsu Osen area. Must try the chicken , and the personal rice set with meat . Hi-ball was also strong the way I liked it and came with lemon :) , some places don’t give you lemon . Anyways there is a lot of dishes on the menu , I would love to try the all but I’m too full

2306.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

2307.a: Tateshina Tokyu Hotel, 鹿山-4026-2 Kitayama, Chino, Nagano 391-0301, Japan
2307.aj: 〒391-0301 長野県茅野市北山鹿山４０２６−２ 蓼科 東急ホテル
2307.ed: Warm rooms & cottages in a wood-and-stone hotel offering 2 restaurants & a private garden.
2307.edj: 温かみのある客室とコテージを備えたホテル。建物には木と石があしらわれている。2 軒のレストランとプライベート ガーデンあり。

rv.t: Wonderful views from the hotel room and amazing location. Came here during the Animal Crossing collaboration and had a wonderful time!

It was a great stay in Tateshina resort area. Builing itself was quite old but has an warm atomosphere. While having dinner, we really loved the water glass they use so we asked them whoch brand ones they are, then waiters shortly check the brand and gave us even QR code of website. We are really impressed their hospitality. Also food was delicious.

I stayed here for one night in September. It is one of the hotels in Tokyu Resort, and the hot spring is in a separate building. It is a 2-3 minute walk from the hotel, but there is also a shuttle bus service available, so you don't have to worry about bad weather or cold days.||The hotel was built many years ago, and although the facilities are old, they are well maintained and there are no particular…

2308.a: NASPA New Otani, 2117-9 Yuzawa, Minamiuonuma District, Niigata 949-6101, Japan
2308.aj: 〒949-6101 新潟県南魚沼郡湯沢町湯沢２１１７−９ NASPA New Otani（ナスパニューオータニ）／新潟・越後湯沢
2308.ed: Cozy rooms in a laid-back property offering low-key dining, an indoor heated pool & skiing.
2308.edj: 居心地の良い客室を備えたゆったりしたホテル。落ち着いたダイニング、屋内温水プール、スキー場あり。

rv.t: What can I say, we booked the Japanese room in this hotel at the last minute and it was a great surprise! The room was very spacious and comfortable, the beautiful design (especially the vintage radio) is a great plus, and the view on the mountains is just amazing. Very good price for what we had. The staff are very nic. And guess what, a big public onsen is free to access. You can also book a private onsen, but the…

Here This is a nice hotel with a good location and a convenient shuttle service. The ski garden is very enjoyable for both children and adults. We stayed in a Japanese-style room with a beautiful view, which made the stay even more pleasant.However, the checkout time feels too early at 10:00 AM, especially considering that check-in is only available from 3:00 PM.Another issue was the futon bed setup. The hotel…

The hotel itself is a 4 star rated. Though it is not near Echigo Yuzawa train station, they have free shuttle service coach bus till around 940pm so even if you have 7 luggage, it’s still fine. We stayed at Japanese western style 50sqm. It’s spacious good for a family with kids. The place is super super clean. The staff are very friendly and helpful. They explained everything in details and helpful in resolving our…

2309.a: Japan, 〒299-5218 Chiba, Katsuura, Kobado, 446-1 NAGU KATSUURA
2309.aj: 〒299-5218 千葉県勝浦市小羽戸４４６−１ NAGU KATSUURA

rv.t: 2026年3月下旬に、8歳の息子と2人で1泊しました。グランピングというのは初めてで不安もありましたが、息子も大満足の経験ができました。でもやはり初めてで勝手がわからないことがあり、そういう点では2度目はもっと充実したグランピングができると感じました。 まず、サウナですが、キャンプ素人には薪に火をつけるのが難しかったです。私はこれをナメていたので、15時にチェックインしたあと少しダラダラと過ごしてしまい、火付け→サウナ準備→サウナ⇔水風呂→シャワーに2時間半ほど要してしまいました。 サウナをじっくり！と考えている人は、早々に薪に火をつけてサウナの準備をすることをお勧めします。ウチはなんとか火がついて、その後は順調に63℃まで温度を上げることができました。さっさとサウナ準備を始めていれば、もっとサウナ⇔水風呂ができたのに、、とそこが反省点です。…

【NAGU KATSUURA】 グランピング×プライベートサウナで大満足の施設 お部屋は冷暖房完備のロータスベルテントでベットも広くゆったりと休憩。 またサウナはテントごとに専用のダイニングスペース。個別のシャワールーム・トイレ完備。 木々に囲まれた自然の中には貸切テントサウナ、水風呂、インフィニティーチェアも完全貸し切りで使用可能 料理も大満足でサウナも2回は入れて大満足なグランピング施設！！ 🍽️料理 〈前菜〉 食前酒or食前ジュース 漬物 彩りカップサラダ 〈焼き物〉 肉巻き２種 ハッセルバックポテト 有頭海老ブラックタイガー 薩摩赤鶏モモ肉100g 熟成牛サーロインステーキ100g 〈ご飯もの〉 勝浦たんたんパエリア めざめの朝食 たまごサンドウィッチ しらすサンドウィッチ ハッシュドポテト 骨付きソーセージ コンスープ バーニャカウダ フルーツのゼリー

初のテントキャビンということで、家族は不安がってましたが、とても楽しめました。 まずスタッフの方が感じが良かったです。 食事も夕食のバーベキュー、朝食のサンドイッチ共に美味しかったです。特に朝食はヘルシー、かつ食べやすくて家族でも高評価でした。 星空も曇りで見れないと思っていたのですが、夜中に一時的に凄く見れる時間があって素敵な星空を夫婦で見ることが出来ました。 貸し出して貰ったiPadに星座アプリがあって、何が見れたのか直ぐ分かったのも良かったです。 少し残念だったのは水回りに結構サビがあったのと、サウナがあまり暑くなかったことですね。サウナは自分のやり方が悪かったのもしれませんが。

2310.a: Kamakura Park Hotel, 33-33-6 Sakanoshita, Kamakura, Kanagawa 248-0021, Japan
2310.aj: 〒248-0021 神奈川県鎌倉市坂ノ下３３−３３−６ 鎌倉パークホテル
2310.ed: Sleek hotel featuring a spa, a cafe & 2 restaurants, plus complimentary Wi-Fi & parking.
2310.edj: スパ、カフェ、2 軒のレストラン、無料 Wi-Fi、無料駐車場のあるおしゃれなホテル。

rv.t: room was quite spacious! the location was great, about a 10 minute walk from our main destination spots and a minute walk from a cafe next door for late night munchies. the service was good but the only thing that was annoying was having to return our room key to the staff everytime we leave. other than that everything was great and free parking!

We had a wonderful oceanview room at this hotel. The room was very spacious as it also had a sofa bed in a niche in the corner. Yes, it is a little dated but none the less the room offered more than adequate amenities for our two night stay in this wonderful town. We had a complimentary breakfast for our stay. We chose the Western cuisine and it was not disappointing. The coffee was delicious! Overall a pleasant and…
This hotel is beautiful, elegant, and truly a special place. The hotel is decorated beautifully with very large elegant rooms. The hotel is romantic and all of the rooms have a view of the water.

2311.a: Jozankei Yurakusoan, 3 Chome-228-1 Jozankeionsenhigashi, Minami Ward, Sapporo, Hokkaido 061-2301, Japan
2311.aj: 〒061-2301 北海道札幌市南区定山渓温泉東３丁目２２８−１ ゆらく草庵
2311.ed: Guests mention this ryokan offers beautiful traditional decor, private in-room onsen baths, and delicious multi-course dinners and breakfasts. They also highlight the relaxing public baths, complimentary late-night ramen, and various free snacks and drinks. Visitors appreciate the warm, attentive staff and the convenient shuttle bus service from Sapporo.
2311.edj: この旅館を利用した人からは、美しい和風の装飾、部屋に備え付けられた温泉風呂、そして美味しい会席料理の夕食と朝食が高く評価されています。また、リラックスできる大浴場、無料で提供される夜食のラーメン、さまざまな無料のお菓子や飲み物も好評のようです。温かくきめ細やかなスタッフの対応や、札幌からの便利な送迎バスサービスも利用した人に喜ばれています。

rv.t: Jozankei Yurakusoan was easily one of the highlights of our stay in Hokkaido. From the moment we checked in, it was clear that a lot of thought had gone into creating a relaxing and memorable guest experience. Every little detail from the warm hospitality to the thoughtful amenities made us feel well looked after. The biggest highlight was undoubtedly the onsen. The public hot spring baths were excellent, and our…

Absolutely wonderful ryokan with 1 public and 4 private onsens, in-room hot spring water bathtub, and kaiseki-style dinner and breakfast. The rooms have all the modern utilities but they pay a LOT of attention to styling the rooms and the corridors and other common spaces to make things feel like a "real" traditional ryokan. The four private onsens are available to use on first-come first-serve queue basis and are…

I have stayed in Dormy Inn hotel group for many times and this is the worst experience I have ever had. ||||The location is good, next to the bus station. Facilities are new and clean. ||||Some staff are attentive with warm hospitality but some are not. If you are looking for traditional Japanese Onsen Ryokan experience, this is definitely not the place. And if you are looking for normal hotel’s service, it’s not…

2312.a: AoAwo Naruto Resort, Oge-16-45 Narutocho Tosadomariura, Naruto, Tokushima 772-0053, Japan
2312.aj: 〒772-0053 徳島県鳴門市鳴門町土佐泊浦大毛１６−４５ アオアヲナルトリゾート
catj: ミーティング プランニング サービス
2312.ed: Warm rooms in a casual waterfront hotel offering beach access, 4 restaurants & an outdoor pool.
2312.edj: 温かみのある客室を備えた水辺のくつろぎのホテル。ビーチに近く、4 軒のレストランと屋外プールがある。

rv.t: For breakfast, I opted for the Japanese-style buffet. While they offer both Western and Japanese options, I was in the mood for rice, so the Japanese buffet was the perfect choice. A great feature during busy holidays is their queuing system—you can join the waitlist from your room using a QR code, which is very convenient. There’s something special about a hotel breakfast buffet, isn’t there? I always find myself…

This resort is geared for family, many families bring their younger children, a refreshing view. It is a nice resort but by no means luxurious. We chose Japanese restaurant for dinner instead of their suggested buffet restaurant (dinner is included in the price), and the kaiseki served was mediocre in taste and quality. We indulge for breakfast, there are two restaurants, one a buffet serving western food, and the…

Very welcoming staffs. Great value with this level of service and experience, including breakfast and dinner. You got four or five restaurants as options for dinner. We had BBQ and Kaiseki, both delicious and impressive. You can get a taste of local specialties. We stayed in the south building but the main building looks more premium and probably newly renovated.

2313.a: Takayama Green Hotel, 2 Chome-180 Nishinoisshikimachi, Takayama, Gifu 506-0031, Japan
2313.aj: 〒506-0031 岐阜県高山市西之一色町２丁目１８０ 高山グリーンホテル
2313.ed: Unfussy rooms in a laid-back hot spring hotel featuring a bathhouse & 5 restaurants.
2313.edj: シンプルな客室を備えたくつろぎの温泉ホテル。大浴場と 5 軒のレストランがある。

rv.t: This was my son's first experience in a Japanese traditional ryokan. According to him, the experience of just one night there was wonderful. As for me, I would like to be provided more service such as yukata for free, however, I was surprised that I had to pay an additional 700 yen for the yukata despite of the ryokan's high score.The hotel itself is quite large, there are an old main building and a new one…

Stayed here for 1 night with a Gate 1 Group Tour of Japan. Stayed here between Kanazawa and Kyoto stops. Quiet area. Some shopping is nearby. One of the best souvenir stores is located adjacent to the hotel. |||Pros:||Spacious room.|Amazing dinner buffet! Sushi, Sushimi, Fish, Meat...etc. |Great breakfast buffet too! |2 nice comfortable beds. Very quiet at night. |Great toilet, with all the standard amenities, in…

Luxurious, nothing is too much trouble for the very welcoming staff. It was raining as we arrived and ny brolly was immediately put into a plastic bag, they have comfortable indoor clothing and slippers you can use around the hotel grounds. We did not use the Onsen as my husband hasvery latge tattoos. Room amazing, comfortable double bed and separate bathroom and toilet. All amenities catered for, inc hsirbrush…

2314.a: Miyako Resort Shima Bayside Terrace, 3618-33 Agocho Ugata, Shima, Mie 517-0501, Japan
2314.aj: 〒517-0501 三重県志摩市阿児町鵜方３６１８−３３ 都リゾート 志摩 ベイサイドテラス
2314.ed: Spanish-style hotel with 3 restaurants, a spa & bay views, plus an outdoor pool & tennis courts.
2314.edj: 湾を一望できるスペイン風ホテル。レストラン 3 軒、スパ、屋外プール、テニスコートを併設。

rv.t: MIYAKO Ressort Shima Bayside Terrace is part of the Kintetsu Group, so I went with certain expectations and consulted other reviews beforehand. From a room price perspective, MIYAKO Ressort Shima Bayside Terrace is positioned in the mid-to-high range. I booked a Deluxe Twin Room with two meals included. Dinner was a French feast at Marena Shima, featuring Ise lobster and abalone, Matsusaka beef, and venison, costing…
Great illustration for a Lationo hotel resort in terms of building design and atmosphere. The villa is spacious and giled up with tranquility. Nice and delicate meals are served.

We had a very pleasant stay at Miyako Resort Shima Bayside Terrace. The casual French dinner was excellent, with both fish and meat dishes served, and everything was beautifully prepared and delicious. The atmosphere was calm and elegant, and the staff were very kind. We would definitely like to come back again.

2315.a: Japan, 〒413-0233 Shizuoka, Itō, Akazawa, Akazawa Onsen Hotel, 字浮山１６３−１

rv.t: It’s a great hotel with indoor and outdoor hot spring. Hotel guests are able to free access to the Akazawa Day Spa which is very beautiful and fantastic just next building . Further, as hotel guests, we have free excess to the other facilities like bowling and lounge with free drinks. The Arena Pleasure is great for families! Great recommended for couples, friends &/or families. The breakfast spread has lots of…

Amazing place to rest and relax especially with family! The place where both kids and adults will have lots of fun! The facilities are incredible, very stylish and luxury feel. We only stayed one night and regret not booking for two nights. You can use all facilities for free even after checkout. Several lounge areas where you can have free drinks and snacks. Highly recommended 10/10!

A very beautiful Onsen hotel with choices of outdoor and indoor Onsen. As hotel guests, we have access to the Akawaza Day Spa in the adjoining building. Further, they grant hotel guests free access to 3 different facilities nearby. They are Pleasure Arena which is great for children with trampolines and the likes. Graz Earth Field where there is a hot spring facility, great food and free drinks and you can relax in…

rv.t: Stayed at Karuizawa Marriott Hotel and overall, it was a solid and relaxing stay. The hotel is quite a distance from the main town area, but that’s also part of its charm being quiet, and has a nice resort style atmosphere. There’s ample free parking, which makes it very convenient if you’re driving. Checkin was smooth and efficient. The rooms are spacious, modern, and well-equipped with thoughtful amenities, making…

Visited in March 2026 as a weekend escape. Stayed in the North Wing's 2nd-floor premium room with an in-room hot spring view bath — a design that delivers exactly what it promises.|The North Wing offers two hot spring experiences under one stay. The in-room Shiozawa Onsen (a saline spring with excellent heat-retention properties) fills a deep soaking tub positioned against a large window overlooking the winter…

★☆☆☆☆ The biggest disappointment was the complete lack of transparency. We stayed in the North Wing, which actually costs more than the Main Building, expecting a better experience. Instead, we were only informed after check-in that North Wing guests are not allowed to wear yukata when walking to the Main Building to use the public onsen and must change into their own outdoor clothes. This restriction was not…

2317.aj: 〒646-0011 和歌山県田辺市新庄町２９０１−１ ホテルハーヴェスト南紀田辺
2317.ed: People say this hotel offers stunning ocean views from all rooms and features a wide variety of delicious buffet options for breakfast and dinner. They also highlight the exceptional quality of the hot spring baths, noting the water leaves skin feeling smooth and soft. Guests mention the staff are friendly and helpful, contributing to a comfortable and relaxing stay.
2317.edj: 海辺の上品なリゾートホテル。オーシャンビューの温泉大浴場と露天風呂を備え、エステルームや屋内温水プール、パターゴルフ場を完備する。

rv.t: Stayed here withy family for a small vacation. Close to adventure world. Kid loved exploring the pools on low tides, breakfast and dinner are delicious with loads of options. The staff are incredibly friendly and helpful with tickets or anything you need. View is abso stunning and the whole facility is kept very clean. As with a lot of places like this, it's sad that I cannot enjoy the onsen due to having tattoos…

Came here to spend a relaxing weekend for my birthday and got frustrated on the first 15 minutes in, for three major reasons: 1) I was looking forward for the pool and onsen. Since it is Japan, I've searched in the hotel website to find any information regarding tattoos prohibitions and there wasn't anything about it. For my unlucky surprise, after the check in I discovered that tattoos aren't allowed. Sadly it was…

I have stayed in many hotels in Japan and this is in my top five. Really top drawer in every aspect. If I had to find something to complain about, it would be the lack of restaurants in the area. But part of the charm of the hotel is the location away from the city, so that is the price you pay. Delightful staff!!

2318.a: Hotel Harvest Arima Rokuisai, Tokyu Harvest Club Arima Rokusai, 341-1 Arimacho, Kita Ward, Kobe, Hyogo 651-1401, Japan

rv.t: I have no complaints at all about this hotel, in fact only praise. The view from the lobby and the rooms is spectacular. The dinner and breakfast buffets had great variety and warm staff always willing to help you. The hotel itself was clean and chic. The rooms were very spacious and sitting on the balcony with my wife enjoying our complementary sparkling wine after dinner was a real highlight! The onsen was…

A fantastic place with incredible service! The hotel offers a shuttle service to Arima Onsen Station. It's a large hotel with many floors and rooms, and the views from both the lobby and the rooms are spectacular. Although the hotel is quite big, you won't get lost, as Ms. Hina Nushiyama provided clear directions regarding the location of the rooms, onsen, and restaurants at check-in. There’s also a small path that…

what a wonderful place. We enjoyed a suite and the Onsen. It was very relaxing and we felt wonderful afterwards. Be aware that this is a traditional Onsen and is enjoyed naked. We also went outside to the onsen pool and watched the stars come out. The restaurant had a wonderful buffet with choices for any palate, both western and japanese. We were able to do laundry, and had fun in the game room while we waited.

2319.ed: Modern hot spring hotel providing indoor & open-air bathhouses, on-site dining & a lounge bar.
2319.edj: モダンな温泉ホテル。内湯と露天風呂、施設内レストラン、ラウンジバーがある。

rv.t: Very nice hotel with private onsen on the balcony. We were there around the first week on November 2024 and the foliage is at it’s peak. Dinner is very good but buffet breakfast is average. There are 2 options for breakfast, either set menu western style breakfast or a buffet.

Another beautiful Harvest facility. We very much enjoyed our stay. The room was spacious and beautifully furnished, as was the open-air bath with a view of the mountains. We also enjoyed the happy hour. The only quibble is the location. We don’t mind being away from the activity and having to walk, but the surrounding area is not particularly attractive to walk through - rather usual in Kyoto. However, you can…

The grounds, the hotel, the restaurants on the grounds are all amazing. We decided after flying from New York to spend two days here to recover from our jet lag. This was the best decision. Wonderful place and would definitely visit again in the future.

rv.t: Room larger than standard hotel rooms in Japan. Limited number of English speaking staff. Buffet style breakfast was very good.

The walk to the hotel is inconvenient if we have big luggages. The hotel room is old but we love the room space. With 3 beds, we have plenty of walking space. We enjoyed the spacious bathroom. The hotel staffs should proactively ask if we are member of its hotel group. We bought souvenirs and forgot to show our member to get a discount.

Beautiful lobby, spacious but a little dated guest rooms. Large shower room in bathroom. Wonderful location close to 3 convenience stores and a few blocks from Nishiki Market with many restaurant options. Very friendly and helpful staff members.

2321.a: Hotel Biwa Lake Otsuka, 1054-3 Minamikomatsu, Otsu, Shiga 520-0502, Japan
2321.aj: 〒520-0502 滋賀県大津市南小松１０５４−３ ホテル琵琶レイクオーツカ
2321.ed: Tranquil lakeside hotel with relaxed rooms & a restaurant, plus an indoor bathhouse.
2321.edj: くつろげる客室を備えた静かな湖畔のホテル。レストラン、屋内大浴場あり。

rv.t: It is a very nice hotel with tasty authentic Japanese dinner and breakfast. Hah！I finished them all. Room is big and cozy with Biwa lake in front of our room window and a massage chair freely use. Bed is comfy and we had a good night sleep. The hotel is clean and onsen is great. Unfortunately it was raining heavily else it will be great to stroll longer along Biwa Lake. Overall, highly recommend.

The food makes my tummy happy! I stayed for 2 nights and they made an effort to put variation in my meals. Seafood tastes so fresh! The private baths were also lifesaver for those who don't want to go naked in front of everyone. I was able to take a dip into the lake for a few hours before it started raining again. But rain or shine, the view is serene. Happy!
If you're cycling around Lake Biwa, I highly recommend staying here, and getting both meals. Reasonably priced, delicious food, beautiful surroundings. I'm glad I had the chance to stay here.

rv.t: Wonderful place high on the lake, far away from hustle and bustle of the cities. I would not recommend this area for future travelers that are not interested in either a long hike, or are without a car, as the location is very isolated. There is very little in the way of English spoken here, so please take some time to study the basics of the language to at least make the best of your experience. The biggest…

It has the most spacious rooms I have ever seen in a Japanese hotel. The lake view is stunning. The breakfast buffet was comprehensive, with nice extras such as freshly squeezed mandarin juice, espresso coffee machine, ice cream etc

We spent a week here. Our room had two western style double beds which were very comfortable. Our room looked out onto the lake. Our dining area was Japanese style with two small futon, a low table and cushions to sit on the floor. That worked for me but not my 6' 1" companion. We moved the futons against the wall and piled the cushions on his futon to make it higher. Used the wall as back support. That worked well…

rv.t: I wanted to visit the Shiraito waterfall and snow in Karuizawa so i thought it's a good chance to stay in a nice resort if it's not so expensive and Lucky I found this property which i think the price was reasonable and my experience from this stay was so enjoyable. The hotel has shuttle service to Karuizawa station or about 15 mins walk. The room was big and in Japanese style super cozy and the balcony allowed me…

The room was huge with a living room and plenty of space for my youngest to roam around, Staff was polite and explain to us in details during checked in, The onsen (both indoor and outdoor) was modern and relaxing Breakfast had vast varieties of food to choose from The only cons was we were given a room on the far end of the corridor and it did took about 5mins walk from the room to the open bath onsen

Service staff were excellent! I asked for their help to make a reservation at restaurant for me and they really went all out to help! Amenities at the onsen were top notch skincare products and I even bought some at the store. Hotel was very clean. Do note that if you choose a Japanese style room, you will have to lay the futon out yourself! It’s a short walk from the station but it can get very dark during winter…

Tangram hotel Onsen has too many people and was really crowded. Dinner was better than I expected as well. Ski in ski out. Perfect for family.

Tokyu Group hotels are highly satisfactory, but I was very disappointed in two points here.|The first is the response to the card key malfunction.|When I checked in and tried to enter the room, I could not enter due to a card key malfunction. I was given a spare key, but it took about 20 minutes to fix the problem because the staff was struggling to keep the door open to deal with the card key. I was very…

Members only harvest club, great ski in ski out at Tangram, linked to Madarao mountain and linked to the Tangram Hotel! The facility was aged but in good condition, clean, tidy and great service. Onsen was beautiful, reception and service was helpful, and the facilities, lockers, access to snow and not walking too far to anything was wonderful especially with a young 4 year old. rv.t: Wow was this place amazing!! We loved our stay here, it was our favorite of our 25 day trip. The view is stunning. The rooms were very nice, a welcome change in size from the traditional Japanese rooms. The staff was incredible and so helpful. The meals were delicious and left us feeling more than satisfied each night. The private onsens were fantastic, each one had a different feel.

We had a wonderful stay at La Vista Fuji. The room was clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. The highlight was the incredible view of Mt. Fuji right from the room—it was absolutely breathtaking, especially in the morning. The peaceful atmosphere made our stay even more relaxing. If you’re looking for a hotel with a beautiful Mt. Fuji view, this is definitely a great choice. Highly recommended!

A very nice hotel with (when the mountain allows) great view to the Mount Fuji. Rooms with private onsen are available and i recommend to take half board. The dinner (you can choose your time) is amazing. At arrival you can get some coffee, wine, small dishes. A bigvpublic onsen with a view and some private ones (no need for reservation) are available. The room is cozy and clean and the staff very friendly. Take the…

rv.t: SkiJam Katsuyama offers fantastic skiing in the beautiful mountains. The hotel provides rentals of all ski equipment, even ski jackets. The slopes are great for beginners and intermediate skiers. Even in late March, we had some fantastic snow. Dotted throughout the slopes are several bars to grab a bite or a drink, Aprés style. The hotel is about a 45minute drive from Fukui Station.

The ski ground is just right outside the hotel! They have wonderful facilities and offer sumptuous meals. We booked the all-inclusive package (room, buffet breakfast, buffet dinner, ski lift, spa entrance) and found it a great deal. The best part is the spa when you can relax after skiing for the whole day. They even have an outdoor spa pool which is really a treat. Don't miss it especially on a snowy day, simply…

The best hotel we've visited. |Our boy who loves dinosaurs spent the best time here! The service, entertainment and food for little dino fans are really impressive here!|The onsen is also great with premium natural springs. Highly recommended!

2327.aj: 〒299-5245 千葉県勝浦市興津１９２０ ホテルブルーベリーヒル ホテルブルーベリーヒル勝浦

rv.t: We had a great experience. It was quiet, had a wonderful view, and the staff were approachable. The server was great too, he had a warm smile, and he took very good care of us. The burger is a must-try, and if you order the Katsuura Dandan noodles, pour the entire bottle of the spicy sauce into the noodles. Trust me. Loved it here. Thank you!

We'd been coming here almost every year for almost ten years now and the experience has never disappointing. The property is a large open space, 2/3 the size of Imperial Palace in Tokyo, with dotted buildings. The best thing about this place is being able to turn off your mind all day sitting in front of a wide view of the field, sky, and the ocean in the background. Reachable in less than two hours drive from…

I stay here through work every few months and it is a great retreat from the hustle and bustle of Tokyo. Although the buildings may be slightly dated, they are very big rooms (certainly much bigger than the apartment I live in!) , comfortable furniture and bed, big bathtub (although no communal bath or hot springs available). The service is also very good and I particularly enjoy the spacious and delicious…

rv.t: The Staff were very friendly and accommodating.The service was great,and we enjoyed the sumptuous buffets! The rooms were cozy and we had a great view from our room!

|We just stayed for one night in a tatami room in Hotel Tenbo. There is a nice Japanese-style garden with a red bridge fronting the hotel. It is a nice hotel with many amenities for the comfort and pleasure of guests and good facilities for guests with special needs. The onsen pools and amenities are well equipped and furnished to give guests a wonderful and relaxing experience. Unfortunately, the furniture and…

Do not stay here. I lived in a Japan for years and have traveled around the country. I’ve stayed in many traditional Japanese inns. This was the worst. ||The location is good and so are the hot spring facilities. But there are a lot of choices for travelers seeking hot springs and a decent location.||The good was mediocre and lacked good taste and variety. |The cut of meat for the Shabu Shabu was inferior.||The…

Very good and friendly service from the hotel staff. Good hot spring bath with both internal bath and external open air bath. Excellent food for dinner and breakfast with many dishes. Wonderful view of the forest, mountains and river from my room.

rv.t: We stayed here for hiking in Nasudake. Hotel itself looked quite new and very spacious. We enjoyed the hot spring as well. The room was also spacious and clean. The best thing was the buffet at the restaurant. Every food was really tasty both dinner and morning. They had a nice souveir store in the hotel. It was a pleasurable stay.

A beautiful hotel under the Harvest group. The space is very spacious, beautifully decorated, and has complete facilities, even a library. The restaurant has good service. Parking is wide and free. You should check the map carefully as you may get lost. We love this place and will definitely visit again.

The hot springs, indoor pool, small game center, ping-pong room, and karaoke room make it fun to stay inside the hotel. There are also desks and chairs with table lamps in the library, so you can work for long hours while enjoying the nice view. The restaurant in the hotel is rather expensive. But you can enjoy luxurious Japanese cuisine in a relaxed atmosphere. The hotel is far from Nasu Kogen Station and any other…

2331.aj: 〒879-5196 大分県由布市湯布院町川南１０８−１ ゆふいん山水館

rv.t: Nice and cosy place. Room is clean and spacious. The facilities is standard. Dinner buffet offers a nice variety of Japanese and Western dishes and dessert, highlight is the otoro and crab leg

We came here for an extra night before the start of our cycle tour. Hotel is dated, but the facilities and service were very good. Ground floor guest area includes free coffee, low alcohol mixers & beer, ice cream, massage machines etc. Onsen was very good. We had a western room which was spacious and comfortable. Great breakfast buffet. Coin laundry conveniently located about 200m from hotel. Rail and bus stations…

I had a spacious room with a beautiful view of Mount Yufu. Although it is an old hotel but it is well kept and the staff are very friendly and helpful. Old fashioned onsen hotel charm. The onsens are spacious and great, free massage chairs in the lobby, a play room for the kids on level 2, and all you can drink alcohol and soft drinks in the lobby until midnight. Breakfast and dinner also fantastic with a great…

rv.t: We had the worst experience staying at this hotel. Tired of the fake hospitality and the drone culture (I am Japanese and I grew up here, lived here for over 20 years) and yeah you can say the usual if you don’t like it, don’t come. I’m saying this because things can change, for the better. We were charged an additional ¥19,000 per night for our two kids (both under 6), which is by far the highest extra fee we’ve…

In my 30+ years of having stayed at hotels, this hotel is by far the cleanest hotel I've ever stayed at. Everything bright, crisp and dry. The floor feels so comfortable to walk on barefoot. All the items in the hotel look brand new. Even the bathroom is so comfortable that you don't mind just taking your time to relax in there.

We stayed at Korakuen a second time. It was a pleasure to stay again. Our room was in the new wing, very nice and comfortable with a great sea view and view of Atami. The staff here are just great. We used the Fuua spa facility. It is a great place with many floors of "relax space". Good for chilling out for the day. The onsen was good with a nice infinity style bath. You can use the restaurant as well via the…

2333.a: Hotel Okura Tokyo Bay, １番地８号 Maihama, Urayasu, Chiba 279-8585, Japan
2333.aj: 〒279-8585 千葉県浦安市舞浜１番地８号 ホテルオークラ東京ベイ
2333.ed: Premium quarters at a high-end hotel offering 4 eateries & a bar, plus a spa & a gym.
2333.edj: 豪華な客室を備える高級ホテル。4 軒のレストラン、バー、スパ、ジムがある。

rv.t: First I want to acknowledge this has absolutely nothing to do with the staff or service at this hotel. They were wonderful and so hospitable.||This has EVERYTHING to do with the quality of the hotel. Complete misrepresentation of a 5 star hotel. ||You could tell this was a regal and once opulent hotel, but it is so past its prime. Outdated in every corner of the building. Nothing has been replaced since its opening…

Hotel Okura Tokyo Bay is a clean and comfortable hotel with a very convenient location for visiting Tokyo Disney Resort. ✨ The room was surprisingly spacious, especially the bathroom, which was much bigger than I expected. I also loved that there was a foot massager in the room, such a nice touch after a long day of walking around the parks! 👣🤍 Another highlight was the view. I could even see Cinderella Castle from…

Good, but something feels off. The rooms are spacious and the bathroom is amazing. Better than the surrounding hotels. Also the price is much better than the others. Sure I would stay here again because of it. We stayed at the executive room, which had a nice decor, but the rest of it felt old and the airco was not doing so great. Also the rest of the hotel looks really old. Somehow it feels that they don't put any…

2334.a: La Vista Yokosuka-Kannnonzaki Terrace, 2 Chome-1157-2 Hashirimizu, Yokosuka, Kanagawa 239-0811, Japan
2334.aj: 〒239-0811 神奈川県横須賀市走水２丁目１１５７−２ ラビスタ横須賀観音崎テラス
2334.ed: People say this hotel offers stunning ocean views from all rooms and features five private baths, a large public bath, and a rock bath. Guests also highlight the delicious and abundant meals, including fresh seafood and local dishes, and the attentive staff. Some reviews mention the building can be worn.
2334.edj: クチコミによると、このホテルは全室から素晴らしいオーシャンビューが楽しめ、5つの貸切風呂、広い大浴場、岩風呂が備わっていると評判です。新鮮な海の幸や地元の食材をふんだんに使った、美味しくてボリューム満点の食事も高く評価されており、スタッフの丁寧な対応も好評のようです。 一方で、建物の古さが気になるという声も一部で聞かれます。

rv.t: The hotel staff are very friendly and clearly do their best to keep the property running smoothly. The hotel is clean and attentive to guests’ needs. However, the building itself feels quite worn. While it has been renovated, some details still show signs of age. For example, the sofa in the room has lost its shape — the cushioning provides little support, and you can feel the wooden frame when sitting on it. The…

The hotel is a hidden gem just one hour or so from Tokyo. Wonderful location on the coast, with almost all rooms having a great view of Tokyo Bay. Lots of little extras such as coffee and cookies while you wait to check in, and late-night noodles as you come back from the terrific spa and baths on the premises. Staff are friendly and helpful, and the breakfast choice - while weighted in favour of Japanese food - is…

The trip was okay, the bath and spa are very spacious and the view is quite stunning as well. We did not like the second floor view from our room as it was pointed to the inner garden with mobile home trucks and obstructed by trees. Everything else was just fine.

2335.a: Naruko Onsen Yumoto Kissho, Yumoto-58-10 Narukoonsen, Ōsaki, Miyagi 989-6823, Japan
2335.aj: 〒989-6823 宮城県大崎市鳴子温泉湯元５８−１０ 鳴子温泉 湯元吉祥
2335.ed: Sleek rooms in a modern hot spring hotel with a restaurant, plus indoor & outdoor bathhouses.
2335.edj: 温泉露天風呂を備えた和洋室や、日本庭園を望む離れの客室もある洗練された温泉旅館。夕食には会席料理を中心としたブッフェを提供する。

rv.t: 4/2026 Reservation through Rakuten. Friday night. Room and futons were very clean, got to choose our yukata, got great post-bath free noodles late at night, both private onsen rooms and large public baths were satisfying, and breakfast buffet was amazing and so worth it, in semi-private rooms! In addition, less than a ten minute walk away was a nice izakaya that we enjoyed. Overall very impressive and grateful for a…

We had a conflicting experience. Some of the staff was really helpful and welcoming, talking to us in Japanese. Others directly went to their translators not even saying one word to us (even though I speak Japansese). The overall room quality was good but i was superdusty in some places. Don’t have ornaments out if they only going to collect dust. I have an allergy and they were not helpful. I tried several times to…

A very nice onsen hotel with 4 private onsen rooms to use. I tried all the rooms. There are two rooms bigger. 莲and 翠。I also try the big bath public bath on 6th floor. Equally good with outdoor pool. The breakfast and semi buffet dinner are great. Value for money to stay on this old onsen. Love the place.

2336.a: Tos Love Tateyama Luana, 833-1 Sunomiya, Tateyama, Chiba 294-0223, Japan
2336.aj: 〒294-0223 千葉県館山市洲宮８３３−１ トスラブ館山 ルアーナ
2336.ed: Guests mention this resort hotel offers spacious, spotless rooms with peaceful views and delicious, beautifully presented meals. They also highlight the wide variety of facilities, including a large onsen, karaoke, and ping-pong, which are enjoyable for families. Visitors appreciate the attentive staff and the excellent value for the quality of the experience.
2336.edj: このリゾートホテルを利用した人は、広々としていて清潔な部屋と、穏やかな景色を高く評価しています。食事も美味しく、見た目も美しいと評判です。また、広い温泉、カラオケ、卓球など、家族で楽しめる施設が充実していることも特徴です。スタッフの対応は丁寧で、質の高い体験に対して価格以上の価値があると感じる人が多いようです。

rv.t: We had a wonderful 2-day, 1-night staycation at Toslove Tateyama Luana and it was everything we hoped for! The room was spotless, spacious, and beautifully designed — with a cozy tatami corner perfect for tea, a big cabinet with a safety box, and even an extra futon for added comfort. The balcony offered peaceful views, making it a perfect spot to relax. The atmosphere was calm and soothing, ideal for unwinding. The…
Great hotel with an amazing view. Hot springs were relaxing. Kids enjoyed the pool. The massage was fantastic. My only downside was the pillows. They felt like a rock. Food was great!
Great spot, service and installations are perfect.

2337.a: Japan, 〒250-0522 Kanagawa, Ashigarashimo District, Hakone, Motohakone, 110 トスラブ箱根 和奏林
2337.aj: 〒250-0522 神奈川県足柄下郡箱根町元箱根１１０ トスラブ箱根 和奏林
2337.ed: Polished hotel with understated rooms, a communal bathhouse & a bright, casual restaurant.
2337.edj: 簡素な客室、大浴場、明るく気取りのないレストランを備えた洗練されたホテル。

rv.t: 家族旅行で利用しましたが、大満足の滞在になりました。お部屋は開放感のある広さで、大きな窓から眺める緑豊かな森の景色にとても癒やされます。 楽しみにしていた温泉は、無料で利用できる檜の家族風呂があり、プライベートな時間を満喫できました。食事は和食ベースのコース料理をいただきましたが、どれも美味しく、スタッフの方々がとても愛想良くお話し上手で、楽しい時間を過ごせました。 チェックアウトが11時までなので、朝も焦らずゆっくり過ごせるのが嬉しいポイントです。ちなみに日帰り予約なら、温泉と食事がセットで1,500円程で利用できるそうなので、今度はそちらでも気軽に立ち寄ってみたいです。

静かで、ゆっくりと癒やされる時間を過ごすことができました。 建物は1990年代前半に建てられたとのことで古さはありますが、バブル期ならではの贅沢な造りが魅力的です。館内は所々リフォームされており、快適に過ごせました。 お部屋は広々としていて、大浴場も気持ち良く、食事も豪華でとても美味しかったです。チェックイン時に予約制の家族風呂も利用しましたが、こちらも良かったです。 ビリヤードもあり、滞在中も充実した時間を過ごせました。 また、チェックイン時に翌日のランチも予約できたので利用しました。ランチは12時からのため、チェックアウト（11:00）後に1時間ほど待ちましたが、この価格でこの内容のランチが楽しめるお店は、この近くではなかなかないと思います。 総じてとても満足できる滞在でした！
箱根にあるITS健保の組合員が利用できる施設。 今回はなんと1番広いお部屋に泊まりました。 2人では勿体無いくらいの広さ。広々とした和室に、客室のお風呂は檜風呂。一泊では満喫しきれず、次は2泊で応募しようと思います。休日はかなりの倍率なのでいつも平日利用でお世話になっております。

2338.a: TOSLOVE Hakone Viole, 110-108 Motohakone, Hakone, Ashigarashimo District, Kanagawa 250-0522, Japan
2338.aj: 〒250-0522 神奈川県足柄下郡箱根町元箱根１１０−１０８ トスラブ箱根ビオーレ
2338.ed: Guests mention this accommodation offers high-quality Italian full-course meals, with many highlighting the delicious fish dishes and extensive wine list. They also appreciate the spacious rooms with high ceilings, the clean natural hot springs, and the reasonable prices for both meals and drinks. Others also say the staff provides attentive and flexible service, especially for dietary needs.
2338.edj: クチコミによると、この宿泊施設は質の高いイタリアンのフルコース料理を提供しており、特に魚料理が美味しいという声や、ワインの種類が豊富だという意見が多くあります。また、天井が高く開放感のある広い部屋や、清潔な天然温泉も高く評価されています。食事や飲み物の価格が手頃である点も好評です。その他、スタッフはきめ細やかで柔軟なサービスを提供しており、特に食事の要望にも対応してくれるというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: Lovely Italian Decor and delicious meals. Ashinoko lake is just a short walk away.
Very nice and comfortable service, Very Good room and restaurant food, Great!

妊娠中の妻と2人で、最後の夫婦2人旅行に行こうということで、たまたま抽選に当たったこちらを利用させていただきました。 保養所ということで過度に期待はせずに利用しようと考えていたのですが、実際泊まってみるとサービスの質がとても高く本当に大満足でした。 夕食の際、妊娠中の妻に対して柔軟にメニューをご調整いただいたり、パスタをシェアして食べるために取り皿をお願いしたところ「最初から半分ずつ盛りましょうか？」とご提案いただいたりと、ホスピタリティを感じるシーンが多く心がホカホカする宿泊体験ができました。 料理の味はもちろん良く、スタッフの皆様の接客も相まって、絶対にまた抽選当てて泊まりに来たいな思う宿でした。 次回は子供と一緒に3人で伺いたいと思います！ありがとうございました。

2339.a: Japan, 〒153-0052 Tokyo, Meguro City, Yutenji, 2 Chome−3−2 Stand Bò Bún
2339.aj: 〒153-0052 東京都目黒区祐天寺２丁目３−２ Stand Bò Bún
catj: アジア系無国籍料理店

rv.t: I really don’t understand the negative comments about the food :O Went there in 3 friends, ordered egg plants, banh cuon, fried meat roll and 3 bún - all very nice and the bún were outstanding. The two staff were the nicest and so friendly it really added points to the experience. There aren’t many seats and the furniture is simple, but that’s literally in line with the concept of the place. Will definitely come…

The toilet is really clean and beautiful. Also, the staff is friendly. Their eggplant is delicious but…unfortunately, they don’t have any hot sauce, and the noodles are not my type so~ maybe if they have hot sauce that might help.
They don’t have beef, only chicken and sea food. I asked for a smaller portion of noodles but it seems to have been the normal size instead. For the price, it’s not good value.
